idea-plugin.name: BPMN Compare
idea-plugin.description:
Visual comparison of BPMN 2.0 diagrams with any Git revision, powered by bpmn.io (bpmn-js and bpmn-js-differ).

  • Side by side – the current diagram, unsaved edits included, next to a branch, tag, commit or any revision expression such as HEAD~3. Renamed and moved files are followed.
  • In every IDE diff – pick BPMN diagram in the diff tool selector of the commit dialog, the Git log, Compare with Branch or Compare Two Files; also the way to compare two revisions with each other. The IDE remembers the choice for each kind of diff window.
  • Highlighting of added, removed, changed and moved elements, with filter chips, a change list and badges listing the changed attributes. Collapsed subprocesses show how many changes they hide. Shifts of a few pixels, as modellers make when saving, are not reported as moves.
  • Camunda and Zeebe extensions are compared too – execution listeners, input/output mappings, form fields, task definitions – which bpmn-js-differ alone does not see.
  • Element history – right-click an element to see who changed it, when and why, and open the diff of any of those commits centred on it.
  • Navigation – F7 / Shift+F7 step through the changes; double-click an element to open it in the XML, and Follow caret selects the element you are editing.
  • Export – the change list as Markdown for a pull request, or the diagram with its markers as SVG or PNG.
  • Merge conflicts – ours, the result as it is being resolved, and theirs as diagrams above the IDE's text merge, with the elements both sides changed marked and the open conflicts counted; also in the BPMN Diff tab of a file left in conflict. Meant for merging smaller changes.

  • Synchronized cursor, hover, pan and zoom between both diagrams.
Open a .bpmn file and switch to the BPMN Diff tab, or use Compare BPMN with Branch or Commit… from the context menu.

The plugin is open source under the MIT license. Diagram rendering and diffing uses bpmn-js (© Camunda Services GmbH, bpmn.io license) and bpmn-js-differ (MIT). Copyright and license notices of all bundled third-party packages are included in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt of the plugin distribution.
